title.narrative: Beirut Housing Rehabilitation and Cultural and Creative Industries Recovery

description.narrative: The project aims to support the rehabilitation of prioritized historical housing for the most vulnerable people and to provide emergency support to creative practitioners and entities in the cultural sector in the Port of Beirut explosion areas.
